title: Mean of a balanced lift
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, and choose a coordinate $i$. Form the balanced lift of $f$ to $n+1$ coordinates, after swapping the first coordinate with coordinate $i+1$. The uniform mean of the resulting sign-valued function, viewed as real-valued, is zero.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
